name: codex-claude-code-bridge
description: Run Claude Code from deterministic Codex commands with native runtime permissions, visible conversation inheritance, and multi-image clipboard handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Claude Code commands with native permissions and image handoff.
interface.longDescription: A local bridge that intercepts explicit claude commands (plus /claude aliases in the Codex App) before the Codex model, runs Claude Code with its official permission-prompt MCP interface and all native permission modes, inherits visible Codex conversation, queues multiple Windows clipboard images without manual saving, and keeps a guarded MCP/Skill fallback for model-directed use.
